editorial:
Imagine being so desperate to save a child that you are willing to risk your own soul. You get to follow two brave nuns who decide to break every rule in the Catholic Church to perform a forbidden exorcism. The vibe is heavy and spooky, making you feel the pressure they are under as they fight a demon that the church refuses to acknowledge. It is a wild ride that mixes religious drama with some really scary moments, keeping you on the edge of your seat as they dive into rituals they were never supposed to know about.

What really makes this work is the acting, as you can feel the panic and love the nuns have for the boy. The pacing is quick, though some of the middle parts drag a bit. If you love supernatural thrills, you should definitely check this out.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, the nuns realize the demon cannot be kicked out by prayers alone. One nun has to take the evil spirit into her own body to free the boy. She succeeds in saving the child, but she ends up permanently possessed. The movie ends with her being locked away in a secret basement, showing that saving the boy came with a terrible price. It is a sad but powerful twist that leaves you thinking.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves scary movies about demons and faith.
